# moq_project (Data Source)

Reads a project the token can reach.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "moq_project" "example" {
  id = "p123example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The project's immutable ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `domain` (String) The admitted email domain, or null.
- `domain_access` (Boolean) Whether a verified email domain is admitted.
- `domain_role` (String) Role granted to domain members.
- `name` (String) Vanity name, or null.
- `public` (Attributes) Anonymous access patterns, or null for none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public))
- `role` (String) The token owner's role on the project.
- `spend_cap_micros` (Number) Monthly spending cap in micro-USD, or null for none.

<a id="nestedatt--public"></a>
### Nested Schema for `public`

Read-Only:

- `publish` (Set of String) Patterns anyone may publish to.
- `subscribe` (Set of String) Patterns anyone may subscribe to.
